{"metadata":{"description":"一个dsh的断路重连器，针对长任务的网络/大模型api接口波动，防止任务停滞；切换不同渠道和模型继续完成任务。支持web和cli。","id":"gh:1348357631","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"daruma","slug":"SISCHOI/daruma","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","failover"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个dsh的断路重连器，针对长任务的网络/大模型api接口波动，防止任务停滞；切换不同渠道和模型继续完成任务。支持web和cli。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# daruma"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English · 中文**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"# Daruma — automatic failover & backup channels for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is a great place to run long agent tasks — until a third-party API subscripti"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"on hiccups. Rate limits (`429`), server errors (`500`), network jitter, provider-side model stalls, "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"moderation gatekeeping: any of them kills a long-running task mid-flight. **Daruma catches the failu"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"re and fails over to another channel**, so the session keeps going without you."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The daruma control lives at the right end of the composer tool row, next to the
model selector; clic"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"king it opens the backup-channel picker."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Automatic failover.** When the current model/channel trips after repeated failures (or hits a te"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rminal error like `QUOTA` / `INVALID_CREDENTIAL` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`), daruma switches the *"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"next* request to another channel in your configured chain. The in-flight generation continues on the"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" new channel — no lost sessions. The switch is recorded in the audit log below, not as a row inside "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"the conversation: a plugin session event of an unknown type makes current harnesses refuse to load t"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"hat session.
- **Circuit breaker with persistent, self-healing state.** Each channel carries a healt"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"h record (failures, cooldown) persisted to `~/.dsh/daruma/channel-health.json`. A tripped channel st"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"ays cooled down across restarts — and the **first successful request closes the circuit again**, so "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"recovered channels never linger as zombie `COOLDOWN` entries.
- **Backup channel UI.** A compact sta"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"tus dock next to the model selector shows overall health and your current backup. The backup panel l"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ists candidate models per provider and lets you set/clear the backup channel manually — picked from "},{"id":"p9s12","text":"real traffic, no synthetic speed tests. The same picker is also a **Backup channel** section in Sett"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ings, beside the other plugin sections.
- **Durable JSONL audit log.** Every failover / give-up / bo"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"ot decision is appended to `~/.dsh/daruma/failover-log.jsonl` (2 MiB rotation, best-effort). See Aud"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"iting failovers.
- **Deterministic decision engine.** All recovery logic lives in a pure function pa"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"ckage (`daruma-core`): same failure history + same channel state → same recovery plan. No I/O, fully"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"a-core`): same failure history + same channel state → same recovery plan. No I/O, fully unit-tested."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Daruma rides three of DSH's native extension points:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Mechanism | Owner | Effect |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Retry** | in-box `dsh-llm-retry` | same channel, bounded exponential backoff |
| **Fail over** |"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" `dsh-daruma` | after retry gives up, or on a terminal error, switch to the next routable channel (u"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ser-chosen backup first) |
| **Self-heal** | `dsh-daruma` | the next `agent/pre-step` / `agent/turn-"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"stopping` without a pending failure proves the last request succeeded → reset the breaker |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The host exposes no request-success event, so success is *inferred*: an agent whose previous model r"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"equest never tripped `agent/request-error` is considered healthy at its next step boundary or turn c"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"t never tripped `agent/request-error` is considered healthy at its next step boundary or turn close."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Also listed in the community awesome-dsh-plugin market (searchable via dshmarket)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Add a failover chain to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Option | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `channels` | `[]` | ordered failover chain; the first entry is your normal primary, the rest are f"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"allbacks in priority order |
| `failureBudget` | `3` | consecutive failures before the circuit trips"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" |
| `cooldownMs` | `30000` | how long a tripped channel stays unroutable |
| `giveUpBudget` | `8` |"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" per-agent failover count at which recovery gives up |
| `stateFile` | `~/.dsh/daruma/channel-health"},{"id":"p23s5","text":".json` | where circuit-breaker state persists |
| `logFile` | `<stateFile dir>/failover-log.jsonl` |"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" where the JSONL audit log is written |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Auditing failovers"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Every decision lands as one JSON line in `~/.dsh/daruma/failover-log.jsonl` — one `boot` line per pl"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ugin start (aligning restart boundaries), then one line per failover / give-up:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Why "daruma""},{"id":"p29s1","text":"A Daruma doll is a traditional Japanese roly-poly doll associated with perseverance. Your long tasks"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" are the same: hit them with a `429`, and they get back up."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **自动故障转移。** 当前模型/渠道连续失败（或遇到 `QUOTA` / `INVALID_CREDENTIAL` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 等终止性错误）后，da"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ruma 把*下一个*请求切到你配置的链上的其他渠道，正在进行的生成在新渠道上继续 —— 会话不丢。切换只记入下面的审计日志，不再往会话里写事件：宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。
- *"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"*持久化且自愈的断路器。** 每个渠道有健康记录（失败数、冷却），持久化到 `~/.dsh/daruma/channel-health.json`，重启后冷却中的渠道保持冷却；**第一个成功请求即重新"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"闭合断路器**，早已恢复的渠道不会滞留成僵尸 `COOLDOWN` 记录。
- **备用渠道界面。** 模型选择器旁的状态控件显示整体健康度与当前备用渠道。备用面板按 provider 列出候选模型，"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"手动设置/清除备用 —— 基于真实流量，不做合成测速。同一个选择器也是设置页里的 **备用渠道** 栏目，和其他插件栏目并列。
- **持久化 JSONL 审计日志。** 每次切换/放弃/启动决策都追"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"加到 `~/.dsh/daruma/failover-log.jsonl`（2 MiB 轮转，best-effort）。见审计切换记录。
- **确定性决策引擎。** 全部恢复逻辑在纯函数包（`dar"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"uma-core`）里：同样的失败历史 + 同样的渠道状态 → 同样的恢复方案。无 I/O，完整单测覆盖。"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"#### WSL 注意（Windows 上的 Linux 实测）"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"WSL 会把 Windows 的 PATH 追加在后面，所以裸 `dsh` 可能解析到 `/mnt/c/...` 下的 **Windows 安装**，用 Linux 的 node 去加载它的平台二进制"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"（sharp、koffi）必然失败。`e2e:failover` 现在会在启动任何东西之前直接拒绝 `/mnt/` 开头的宿主并给出修复命令；正确做法是在发行版内装宿主并把它的 bin 目录放到 PA"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"、koffi）必然失败。`e2e:failover` 现在会在启动任何东西之前直接拒绝 `/mnt/` 开头的宿主并给出修复命令；正确做法是在发行版内装宿主并把它的 bin 目录放到 PATH 最前："},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
